label: Numerical propensity law on giving histories
definition: A Mathlib PMF on the existing Boolean giving/withholding histories. A binary law assigns masses p and q with p+q=1; the full-support controls require p,q>0. The three-point law assigns p,p,q with 2p+q=1.
note: The numbers are supplied rather than inferred from accessibility, invariant intrinsic setup, or causal power. Objective causal applicability is a separate commitment.
